description: The `shopping` capability (Homemind's shopping.ts). Each case starts from seed.state.json with the default stores and empty lists, and `steps` are what members did: a request to the lists, several items from chat (`addMany`), or a board change. `log` is what HOPA devices send for them, in order: board ops (v1) and `shopping` ops (v2: item.add, item.addMany, item.remove, item.buy, item.bump, item.unbump, item.setQty, list.clearBought, run.take, run.release, store.add, store.remove, undo); a run's task is a board task, and finishing a run is the board `done` of that task. Each `results` entry is the outcome of one log entry. `after` is, after each step, what the members see: the lists (a finished run's bought items gone; a run following its task's owner) and the board's items. Undo records use the op id of the change they belong to. Generated; do not edit by hand.

cases.name: add-buy-clear
cases.description: Add, a duplicate (refused: first writer wins), more of it, mark bought, unmark, clear what was bought.

cases.name: undo-rules
cases.description: Undo by the author or a parent only, once, and not after someone changed the item since; an undone remove puts the item back in its place.

cases.name: stores
cases.description: A family store (its id from its name), one with no Latin letters (a counted id), a name already there, removing a default store (refused), a store with items (refused), then an empty one.

cases.name: a-run
cases.description: Dad takes the supermarket run (a task on the board), Maya cannot take it too nor release it; Dad buys two things and finishes: the bought items leave the list, the rest stay; an Undo of the done task on the board brings them back.
